name: TradeCore ERP
description: v1.0.9 build 2026-09-08-15 COMPANY-ADD ROOT-CAUSE FIX: v2_upsert_company still returned false with the (correct) normalizeCompanyPayload — real cause: build-14 defined companies.subscription_end as BIGINT but the app's Company.subscriptionEnd is a DATE STRING ('2026-09-30'); MySQL strict mode rejected it (Incorrect integer value) so the INSERT failed with success:false and the frontend's boolean-only v2UpsertCompany hid the real error. Fixes: (1) subscription_end column is now VARCHAR(16) (ADD + MODIFY idempotent) matching the app's string format; (2) tcUpsertCompanyRow calls tcEnsureNormalizedTables first so theme_color/subscription_end/logo columns always exist; (3) server now error_logs '[v2_upsert_company] FAILED SQL: <PDO msg> DATA: <payload>' — the exact line the user can paste; (4) new v2UpsertCompanyDetailed returns the raw response so the console/toast shows the REAL server error (never a bare boolean). Acceptance: add WILLIAM COMPANY -> console [Direct MySQL] v2_upsert_company RESPONSE {success:true} -> SELECT * FROM companies WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC shows the row -> refresh + other browser see it -> no banner. Table is 'companies' (NOT tradecore_companies - that table does not exist and was the rejected duplicate-schema plan).
